# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_launch_windows.py - do not edit manually.

# The legs between the nine fleet locations (solar colonization slice 6 design
# §§ 1.2-2, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-solar-colonization-fleets-design.md),
# for every ordered pair and drive (chemical, fusion, torch, antimatter):
#   sr_leg_months_<drive>_<a>_<b>   the months the leg takes, leaving this month
#   sr_leg_dv_<drive>_<a>_<b>       its delta-v, km/s (tenths for chemical and
#                                   fusion, whole for the torches)
#   sr_leg_*_rapid_<drive>_<a>_<b>  a fleet of rapid response hulls alone: one
#                                   drive ahead; antimatter's at 3/4 its months
# Three kinds of leg:
#   exact  Earth to a location: the body's own windows (sr_launch_offset_<body>),
#          its colony fleets' transit as months
#   cycle  back to Earth, and among Mercury and Venus, Mars, the Belt and Jupiter:
#          the pair's mean synodic cycle, sr_leg_phase_<a>_<b> (hundredths of a
#          month into it, from 1800 so the dividend is positive; a curve reads it
#          directly, so no negative number is rounded)
#   fixed  the rest: one median figure each
# Departure from a planet's system starts in the loose capture orbit (e = 0.9) a
# fleet arrives in; from Earth, in its 200 km parking orbit. Read when a fleet
# departs and when the panel draws its row: no cache. Any scope.

					value = 1361 # offset -3
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < -1 }
					value = 1363 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					value = 1350 # offset -1
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 1 }
					value = 1325 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 1293 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 3 }
					value = 1260 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 1236 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 6 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 5 }
					value = 1230 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 1242 # offset +5
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_launch_offset_saturn < 7 }
					value = 1270 # offset +6
				}
				else = {
					value = 1304 # offset +7
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_months_rapid_chemical_earth_saturn = { value = sr_leg_months_fusion_earth_saturn }
sr_leg_dv_rapid_chemical_earth_saturn = { value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_earth_saturn }

# ===== Mercury and Venus to Earth and the Moon (cycle) =====
# Mean cycle 19.18 months, epoch 415: within 0.48 months of every one of 148 optima.
sr_leg_phase_inner_earth = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = 21600
	multiply = 100
	add = 415
	modulo = 1918
}
sr_leg_months_chemical_inner_earth = {
	value = 5 # every month
}
sr_leg_dv_chemical_inner_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 959 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 450 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 150 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 50 }
					value = 1.8 # offset +0
				}
				else = {
					value = 2 # offset +1
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 250 }
					value = 2.9 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 350 }
						value = 3.7 # offset +3
					}
					else = {
						value = 4.5 # offset +4
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 750 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 550 }
					value = 5.1 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 650 }
						value = 5.7 # offset +6
					}
					else = {
						value = 6.3 # offset +7
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 850 }
					value = 6.8 # offset +8
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 950 }
						value = 7.8 # offset +9
					}
					else = {
						value = 8.7 # offset +10
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1368 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1068 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 968 }
					value = 8.9 # offset -10
				}
				else = {
					value = 10.4 # offset -9
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1168 }
					value = 13.5 # offset -8
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1268 }
						value = 12.7 # offset -7
					}
					else = {
						value = 10 # offset -6
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1668 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1468 }
					value = 7.7 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1568 }
						value = 5.8 # offset -4
					}
					else = {
						value = 4.2 # offset -3
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1768 }
					value = 2.9 # offset -2
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 1868 }
						value = 2 # offset -1
					}
					else = {
						value = 1.8 # offset +0
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_months_fusion_inner_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 550 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 350 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 250 }
				value = 1 # offsets +0 to +2
			}
			else = {
				value = 2 # offset +3
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 450 }
				value = 3 # offset +4
			}
			else = {
				value = 4 # offset +5
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 950 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_inner_earth < 850 }

			}

			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_jupiter_earth < 760 }
					value = 5.6 # offsets +7 to -6

					value = 5.5 # offset -5

			}
		}

# ===== the Saturn system to Earth and the Moon (cycle) =====
# Mean cycle 12.42 months, epoch 1152: within 6.21 months of every one of 228 optima.
sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = 21600
	multiply = 100
	add = 1152
	modulo = 1242
}
sr_leg_months_chemical_saturn_earth = {
	value = 73 # every month
}
sr_leg_dv_chemical_saturn_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 550 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 150 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 50 }
				value = 6.5 # offset +0
			}
			else = {
				value = 6.4 # offset +1
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 450 }
				value = 6.5 # offsets +2 to +4
			}
			else = {
				value = 6.4 # offset +5
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 692 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 621 }
				value = 6.3 # offset +6
			}
			else = {
				value = 6.2 # offset -6
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 892 }
				value = 6.6 # offsets -5, -4
			}
			else = {
				value = 6.5 # offsets -3 to +0
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_months_fusion_saturn_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 550 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 150 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 50 }
				value = 17 # offset +0
			}
			else = {
				value = 19 # offset +1
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 350 }
				value = 23 # offsets +2, +3
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 450 }
					value = 22 # offset +4
				}
				else = {
					value = 21 # offset +5
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 892 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 621 }
				value = 20 # offset +6
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 792 }
					value = 19 # offsets -6, -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 18 # offset -4
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 992 }
				value = 17 # offset -3
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 1192 }
					value = 16 # offsets -2, -1
				}
				else = {
					value = 17 # offset +0
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_dv_fusion_saturn_earth = {
	value = 30 # every month
}
sr_leg_months_torch_saturn_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 550 }
		value = 4 # offsets +0 to +5
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_saturn_earth < 1192 }
			value = 3 # offsets +6 to -1
		}
		else = {
			value = 4 # offset +0
		}
	}
}

	value = 400 # every month
}

	value = 2 # every month

# ===== the Uranus system to Earth and the Moon (cycle) =====
# Mean cycle 12.14 months, epoch 352: within 6.06 months of every one of 233 optima.
sr_leg_phase_uranus_earth = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = 21600
	multiply = 100
	add = 352
	modulo = 1214
}
sr_leg_months_chemical_uranus_earth = {
	value = 193 # every month
}
sr_leg_dv_chemical_uranus_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_uranus_earth < 350 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_uranus_earth < 50 }
			value = 6.4 # offset +0
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_uranus_earth < 150 }
				value = 6.8 # offset +1
			}
			else = {
				value = 6.6 # offsets +2, +3
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_uranus_earth < 864 }
			value = 6.4 # offsets +4 to -4
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_uranus_earth < 1164 }
				value = 6.5 # offsets -3 to -1
			}
			else = {
				value = 6.4 # offset +0
			}
		}
	}
}

# ===== the Neptune system to Earth and the Moon (cycle) =====
# Mean cycle 12.07 months, epoch 1086: within 6.03 months of every one of 236 optima.
sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = 21600
	multiply = 100
	add = 1086
	modulo = 1207
}
sr_leg_months_chemical_neptune_earth = {
	value = 368 # every month
}
sr_leg_dv_chemical_neptune_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 657 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 250 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 150 }
				value = 7 # offsets +0, +1
			}
			else = {
				value = 7.1 # offset +2
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 450 }
				value = 6.9 # offsets +3, +4
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 550 }
					value = 7 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 6.9 # offsets +6, -6
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 957 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 757 }
				value = 7 # offset -5
			}
			else = {
				value = 6.9 # offsets -4, -3
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 1057 }
				value = 7 # offset -2
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 1157 }
					value = 6.9 # offset -1
				}
				else = {
					value = 7 # offset +0
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_months_fusion_neptune_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 604 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 250 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 50 }
				value = 57 # offset +0
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 150 }
					value = 59 # offset +1
				}
				else = {
					value = 64 # offset +2
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 450 }
				value = 63 # offsets +3, +4
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 550 }
					value = 73 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 82 # offset +6
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 857 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 657 }
				value = 81 # offset -6
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 757 }
					value = 59 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 58 # offset -4
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 1057 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 957 }
					value = 64 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					value = 68 # offset -2
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 1157 }
					value = 73 # offset -1
				}
				else = {
					value = 57 # offset +0
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_dv_fusion_neptune_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 50 }
		value = 30 # offset +0
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 1157 }
			value = 29.9 # offsets +1 to -1
		}
		else = {
			value = 30 # offset +0
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_months_torch_neptune_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 150 }
		value = 10 # offsets +0, +1
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_neptune_earth < 1057 }
			value = 9 # offsets +2 to -2
		}
		else = {
			value = 10 # offsets -1, +0
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_dv_torch_neptune_earth = {
	value = 400 # every month
}
sr_leg_months_antimatter_neptune_earth = {
	value = 3 # every month
}
sr_leg_dv_antimatter_neptune_earth = {
	value = 2000 # every month
}
sr_leg_months_rapid_chemical_neptune_earth = { value = sr_leg_months_fusion_neptune_earth }
sr_leg_dv_rapid_chemical_neptune_earth = { value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_neptune_earth }
sr_leg_months_rapid_fusion_neptune_earth = { value = sr_leg_months_torch_neptune_earth }
sr_leg_dv_rapid_fusion_neptune_earth = { value = sr_leg_dv_torch_neptune_earth }
sr_leg_months_rapid_torch_neptune_earth = { value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_neptune_earth }
sr_leg_dv_rapid_torch_neptune_earth = { value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_neptune_earth }
sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_neptune_earth = {
	value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_neptune_earth
	multiply = 0.75
	add = 0.75
	floor = yes
	min = 1
}
sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_neptune_earth = { value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_neptune_earth }

# ===== the Kuiper Belt to Earth and the Moon (cycle) =====
# Mean cycle 12.05 months, epoch 352: within 6.02 months of every one of 238 optima.
sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	subtract = 21600
	multiply = 100
	add = 352
	modulo = 1205
}
sr_leg_months_chemical_kuiper_earth = {
	value = 606 # every month
}
sr_leg_dv_chemical_kuiper_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 603 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 350 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 150 }
				value = 15.2 # offsets +0, +1
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 250 }
					value = 15 # offset +2
				}
				else = {
					value = 15.1 # offset +3
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 450 }
				value = 15.2 # offset +4
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 550 }
					value = 15 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 14.8 # offset +6
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 855 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 655 }
				value = 15.3 # offset -6
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 755 }
					value = 15.2 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 15.1 # offset -4
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 1055 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 955 }
					value = 15.4 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					value = 15.2 # offset -2
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 1155 }
					value = 15.1 # offset -1
				}
				else = {
					value = 15.2 # offset +0
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_months_fusion_kuiper_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 603 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 250 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 50 }
				value = 193 # offset +0
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 150 }
					value = 168 # offset +1
				}
				else = {
					value = 162 # offset +2
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 450 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 350 }
					value = 173 # offset +3
				}
				else = {
					value = 187 # offset +4
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 550 }
					value = 148 # offset +5
				}
				else = {
					value = 144 # offset +6
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 855 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 655 }
				value = 156 # offset -6
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 755 }
					value = 137 # offset -5
				}
				else = {
					value = 139 # offset -4
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 1055 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 955 }
					value = 149 # offset -3
				}
				else = {
					value = 179 # offset -2
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 1155 }
					value = 188 # offset -1
				}
				else = {
					value = 193 # offset +0
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_dv_fusion_kuiper_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 603 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 150 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 50 }
				value = 29.7 # offset +0
			}
			else = {
				value = 29.9 # offset +1
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 550 }
				value = 29.8 # offsets +2 to +5
			}
			else = {
				value = 29.9 # offset +6
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 755 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 655 }
				value = 29.8 # offset -6
			}
			else = {
				value = 29.9 # offset -5
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 1055 }
				value = 29.8 # offsets -4 to -2
			}
			else = {
				value = 29.7 # offsets -1, +0
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_months_torch_kuiper_earth = {
	value = 12 # every month
}
sr_leg_dv_torch_kuiper_earth = {
	value = 400 # every month
}
sr_leg_months_antimatter_kuiper_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 550 }
		value = 4 # offsets +0 to +5
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { sr_leg_phase_kuiper_earth < 603 }
			value = 3 # offset +6
		}
		else = {
			value = 4 # offsets -6 to +0
		}
	}
}
sr_leg_dv_antimatter_kuiper_earth = {
	value = 2000 # every month
}
sr_leg_months_rapid_chemical_kuiper_earth = { value = sr_leg_months_fusion_kuiper_earth }
sr_leg_dv_rapid_chemical_kuiper_earth = { value = sr_leg_dv_fusion_kuiper_earth }
sr_leg_months_rapid_fusion_kuiper_earth = { value = sr_leg_months_torch_kuiper_earth }
sr_leg_dv_rapid_fusion_kuiper_earth = { value = sr_leg_dv_torch_kuiper_earth }
sr_leg_months_rapid_torch_kuiper_earth = { value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_kuiper_earth }
sr_leg_dv_rapid_torch_kuiper_earth = { value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_kuiper_earth }
sr_leg_months_rapid_antimatter_kuiper_earth = {
	value = sr_leg_months_antimatter_kuiper_earth
	multiply = 0.75
	add = 0.75
	floor = yes
	min = 1
}
sr_leg_dv_rapid_antimatter_kuiper_earth = { value = sr_leg_dv_antimatter_kuiper_earth }
